title: GitHub Actions Job Timeout Defaults
text: GitHub-hosted runner에서 각 job의 기본 최대 실행 시간은 360분(6시간)이다. 워크플로에서 timeout-minutes를 따로 지정하지 않으면 이 기본값이 적용된다.

title: Queue Lag SRE Report 2026 Q2
text: 피크 시간대 소비자 lag p50은 12ms, p99는 180ms였다. 서비스 SLA는 엔드투엔드 지연 100ms라서 p99 lag만으로도 예산을 초과한다.

title: FP8 Format Bit Layout
text: The common FP8 E4M3 format uses 1 sign bit, 4 exponent bits, and 3 mantissa bits. FP16 uses 5 exponent bits, so assuming FP8 has 8 exponent bits is incorrect.

title: Nightly Adapter Merge Forgetting Rates
text: Across seven nightly merges, average accuracy on the first task fell by 12 percent. Runs that stayed under 2 percent forgetting required explicit replay or merge constraints.

title: 2026 Tool Calling Accuracy Snapshot
text: On the reported public tool-calling suite, Model X reached 78 percent exact-tool accuracy. Numbers above 90 percent appeared only on a narrower vendor demo set.

title: 2026 Model Latency Benchmark
text: Model A reduced median latency by 24 percent in the tested interactive workload; answer quality was measured on a separate subset.

title: Service Capacity Report
text: 관측 기간의 피크 사용량은 전체 용량의 60퍼센트였지만 장애 시 예비 용량은 포함하지 않았다. 운영 가이드는 예비 용량을 포함한 유효 headroom을 최소 40퍼센트 유지하라고 권고한다.

title: KV Cache Serving Metrics 2026
text: After enabling prefix caching, the median KV cache hit rate was 71 percent and TTFT fell by 18 percent on the interactive trace. Hit rates near 95 percent appeared only on synthetic repeat-heavy prompts.

title: Private Optimization Experiment
text: 동일한 입력 100건 기준 최적화 후 중앙값 처리 시간이 920ms에서 480ms로 줄었고, 감소율은 47.8퍼센트였다.

title: Another User's Private Experiment
text: 다른 사용자 실험에서 처리 시간이 2100ms에서 700ms로 줄었고 감소율은 66.7퍼센트였다.

title: 2024 Model Benchmark
text: Under batch size 32, the previous model completed requests 15 percent faster than the 2026 candidate on the same GPU class.

title: 2026 Conflicting Model Benchmark
text: Under interactive concurrency 8, the newer model was 22 percent faster in median latency, but the suite did not measure batch throughput at all.
